description: A site's name, theme, header, address and every page by path and title, plus its status: a running or failed job (from import_site), its `domain`: none (no domain is asked for), pending (waiting on DNS), live (it serves the site); `hosting`: unclaimed (nobody owns it yet), trial (in its free days), paying (paid for), unpaid (a payment lapsed, and it pauses unless paid), paused (down until paid for), free (never billed); and `payments`: ready (Buy, the cart and donations show), none (its owner has not connected Stripe, so they are hidden), pending (Stripe is still checking the account, so they are hidden), off (miow takes none here). Call before changing a site you did not just create; write_site replaces the header whole, so change it from this one. With `site` and no token, any live site's name, address and pages as it lists them, a wiki's being its articles outside hidden categories, without its status.

site.description: Any live site's address, as acme.miow.me, acme.com or a page's url, to read what anyone can see there without a token

token.description: The site token from create_site or the site's settings. Omit if your Authorization header carries it.

name: get_site
title: Get a site
